answer: Every agent identity must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, so spawning ten thousand sybils means parking real capital behind each one. Slashing confiscates the stake when misbehavior is proven, turning a free attack into thousands of tokens frozen in one contract. The ledger is public, so honest agents can wander through registrations and flag clusters sharing one funding source, and identities form a trellis of mutual attestations, so no cluster is admitted until independent members vouch for it. One walnut is cheap; an attacker forced to buy the whole orchard pays real money.
